intro: Silixiz's Tower Key is a small key carried by Foreman Silixiz outside the Venture Company tower near the Sludge Fen. Horde operatives belonging to the Shattered Hand are tasked with lifting it directly from the foreman's pockets as part of an undercover sabotage assignment.

p: The Venture Company operation north of the Sludge Fen runs under tight security, centered on an isolated lookout tower supervised by Grand Foreman Puzik Gallywix. Outside the compound patrolled by goblin mercenaries, Foreman Silixiz carries the tower key that the Shattered Hand operative is instructed to steal and keep. For the rogue network of the Shattered Hand operating out of Orgrimmar, obtaining this key is not a matter of blunt force; field operatives must slip into the compound undetected and pick the foreman's pockets cleanly, proving their mastery of stealth before climbing into the toxic upper levels.
